shots.vo: Across this ocean waited a battle for dharma. Sita had to be brought home. Ravana had to fall.
And to get there, an army would build what had never been built before. A bridge across the sea.
Stone by stone. Boulder by boulder.
Each one marked with Ram's name, and his faith.
And in the middle of all that grandeur, something much smaller had also arrived.
It couldn't carry boulders.
So it carried what it could.
Of course, one of the vanaras noticed.
And, decided to make a point of it.
He made sure everyone laughed with him.
Even the babies were outdoing it without breaking a sweat.
Naturally, nobody clapped.
But someone else was watching too.
And he wasn't looking at the boulders.
He was looking at the only one who showed up without being asked to.
Some bridges are built with strength. Some are built with heart. The wise ones know you need both.
Some days the sea was calm.
Some days it wasn't.
The squirrel never waited for the right day.
It didn't matter if the tide was high or low that day. The pebble went in anyway.
One pebble, placed once, means nothing. The same pebble, placed again and again, regardless of the day, that's what holds a bridge together.

Most people wait for the right time to invest. The market down, wait. The market up, too late. The squirrel never checked the tide before showing up. It showed up the same way, every time, and let the average take care of the rest.
You don't need to time the market. You need to keep showing up, same amount, every time. That's not a squirrel's trick. That's SIP.
